Name: Report to the Ares Warrior Alliance
Offer: So you made it to the port of Athens. Go through the city gate and report to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master. Tell him the Docker sent you.
Done: The Docker sent you? Good. Athens can always use another captain.

Name: Task of Hides
Offer: Mahmoud of Alexander needs Red Fox hides to make battle uniforms. Hunt three Red Foxes in the suburb and come back to me.
Done: These hides will do nicely. Here is your reward.

Name: Kill Depressed Poet
Offer: There is a Depressed Poet in the suburb who attacks passers-by. He is very strong, so bring Healing Potions. Destroy him and return to me.
Done: The road through the suburb is safe again. Well fought.

Name: Mining Task II: Pig Iron
Offer: The Shipyard Boss at the port needs five pieces of Pig Iron for a ship reconstruction. The Blacksmith sells it. Bring them to him.
Done: Five pieces of Pig Iron, just what the yard needed.
